title: Generalized Freud weight, discrete Painlevé I hierarchy and full asymptotics of Hankel determinants
summary: In this paper, we investigate the monic orthogonal polynomials $P_{n}(x;T_{m};λ)$ and the Hankel determinants $D_{n}(T_{m}; λ)$ associated with the generalized Freud weight \[w(x;T_{m};λ) = |x|^{2λ+1}\exp\biggl(-\sum_{k=1}^m t_k x^{2k}\biggr),\quad m \in \mathbb{Z}^+,\; t_{k} \in \mathbb{R} , x\in\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0\},\] where \(T_{m}=\{t_{1},t_{2},\cdots, t_{m}\}\), $t_{m}>0$ and \(λ>-1\).By employing ladder operators and compatibility conditions, we find that all members of the discrete Painlevé I hierarchy have a unified structure and the recurrence coefficient \(β_n\) of…
